target.outcome: SWS involuntary hunger (% of families), Balance Luzon (Luzon outside Metro Manila)
target.label: HIGH when the quarter's hunger exceeds its preceding-20-quarter normal by more than the round's margin of error (FI6 label, app/fi6/target.py); numeric outcome: the quarter's hunger level
target.geography: regional (Balance Luzon); CALABARZON is ~34% of it; never assigned to provinces or LGUs

protocol.horizon: Lead 1: target = calendar quarter after the issue quarter; issue = last day of the issue quarter's 2nd month
protocol.training_rule: at each issue date train only on rows whose target was published on or before that date
protocol.evaluation_targets: 2010-Q1 .. latest published SWS quarter (walk-forward, expanding window)
protocol.no_tuning: every candidate keeps its FI7 configuration; no hyperparameter or threshold is chosen on FI9 results
protocol.selection: on DEVELOPMENT targets only: among candidates passing the reliability rule, lowest Brier; a candidate other than naive/damped persistence must also beat naive persistence on development Brier with moving-block bootstrap P(diff < 0) >= 0.90. If none passes, the persistence-family member with the lower development Brier is served and the forecast is labelled provisional.
validated_lead1_requires: passes the reliability rule on the full walk-forward period (>= 10 HIGH quarters)
passes it on the test period
passes it without the survey-alternation (sawtooth) quarters
expected calibration error (5 equal-width bins) <= 0.10 on the full period
protocol.probability_display: the probability is shown only if Brier < climatology on the test period and ECE <= 0.10; otherwise the class is shown with 'probability not calibrated'
protocol.ablation: LightGBM (FI7 features) leaving out one domain's government indicators at a time, and all news; a domain 'contributes' when removing it raises Lead-1 Brier with bootstrap P >= 0.90
